name: Mia Martin
source: A studious and introspective student at Lind Academy, Mia prefers the quiet company of novels to the noise of parties. She’s visited Ben’s bookstore since childhood and shares a quiet friendship with the old bookseller. When she brings him a mysterious bracelet to examine, it sets off a chain of events that transforms Lind forever.
